ican: I can state what a mechanism does.
I can name rotary, linear, reciprocating and oscillating motion.
I can draw the symbol for each type of motion.
I can identify the motion of a part of a machine.

cloze.title: Say it the exam way
cloze.text:
A mechanism changes one type of [[motion|material|signal]] into another. A car wheel turning in a circle has [[rotary|linear|oscillating]] motion. A lift moving up in a straight line has [[linear|rotary|reciprocating]] motion.

A jigsaw blade moves back and forth in a straight line. That is [[reciprocating|oscillating|linear]] motion. A swing moves back and forth in an arc. That is [[oscillating|reciprocating|rotary]] motion.

The symbol for reciprocating motion is a [[straight|curved]] line with an arrow head at [[each end|one end]]. The symbol for oscillating motion is a [[curved|straight]] line with an arrow head at each end.

check.a: It changes one type of motion into another, or moves a force from one place to another.

check.q: Name the type of motion of each part: (a) a car wheel, (b) a lift, (c) a jigsaw blade, (d) a swing.

check.a: A straight line with an arrow head at each end.
Linear motion is in a straight line in one direction. Reciprocating motion is backwards and forwards in a straight line.

check.q: Name the type of motion of a sewing machine needle.

paper2.alt: The cam and follower in the diagram below are used to convert motion. A diagram shows a pear-shaped cam turning on a shaft, with a flat follower resting on it that moves up and down. State the type of motion of: the cam; the follower. 2 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2014 Section 1, Question 8. Cam: rotary or rotational. Follower: reciprocating. 1 mark for each correct answer.

paper2.lead: A cam and follower is not in the course any more, but the types of motion are.

paper2.alt: A circus acrobat on a trapeze swing is suspended high above the ground. The motion of the trapeze swing is shown below: a photograph of the acrobat with a curved arrow along an arc. (a) State the type of motion shown. 1 mark.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2018 Question 11(a). Oscillating. 1 mark.

paper2.alt: A pneumatic circuit is used in the operation of an industrial saw. Two diagrams show a circular saw blade on an arm, raised and lowered by a pneumatic piston, cutting a log. (a) State, with reference to the diagram above, the type of motion shown at the saw blade and the pneumatic piston. 2 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2019 Question 10(a). Saw blade: rotary. Pneumatic piston: reciprocating. 1 mark each. Accept rotational or reciprocal. Do not accept rotating.

paper2.alt: Complete the table below which shows the four types of motion. The first one is completed for you. 3 marks. The table has two columns, motion name and graphic. Linear has a straight arrow. Reciprocating has an empty graphic box. The third motion name is blank and its graphic is a circular arrow. Oscillating has an empty graphic box.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2021 Question 1. Reciprocating: a straight line with an arrow head at each end. The circular arrow: rotary. Oscillating: a curved line with an arrow head at each end. 1 mark for each.

paper2.alt: A combine harvester used to gather crops is shown below. The reel at the front turns in a circle and the cutter bar moves back and forth along a straight line. (a) State the type of motion shown above at the reel and the cutter bar. 2 marks.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2023 Question 13(a). Reel: rotary; accept rotational or rotating. Cutter bar: reciprocating; accept reciprocal. 1 mark each.

paper2.alt: A jigsaw used to cut wood is shown. The jigsaw uses a motor and saw blade in its operation. Complete the table below for the motion of the motor and saw blade. 2 marks. The table has columns part, motion symbol and motion name. Motor: a circular arrow is given; the name is blank. Saw blade: the symbol is blank; the name is reciprocating.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2025 Question 5. Motor: rotary; accept rotational. Saw blade: a straight line with an arrow head at each end, drawn up and down or side to side. 1 mark each.

paper2.alt: An electric toothbrush is shown, with a photograph. It is operated by a microcontroller; a table of input and output pins and a sequence of operation are given. The motor and toothbrush head are shown below. (b) Complete the table below for the motion of the motor and toothbrush head. 2 marks. The motor has a circular arrow symbol; the toothbrush head has a curved arrow with a head at each end. Both motion names are blank.

mi.alt: Marking instructions for 2026 Question 12(b). Motor: rotary; accept rotational or rotating. Toothbrush head: oscillating. 1 mark each.

errors: Use the exam word: rotary, linear, reciprocating or oscillating. In 2019, "rotating" got no mark.
Draw reciprocating as a straight line with an arrow head at each end (2021, 2025).
Draw oscillating as a curved line with an arrow head at each end (2021).
Back and forth in an arc is oscillating, not reciprocating: a trapeze swing (2018), a toothbrush head (2026).
